exact.purpose: Repeat the frozen paper configuration with only fail-closed numerical handling.

fallback-v1.purpose: Use a pre-registered tenfold learning-rate reduction when exact recovery is non-finite on either hardware.

selection.originally_affected_rule: union of cells with non-finite first-pass paper metrics on A10G or A100
selection.affected_exact_rule: select exact only when exact is finite on both A10G and A100
selection.affected_fallback_rule: otherwise select fallback-v1 only when fallback-v1 is finite on both A10G and A100
selection.failure_rule: block publication if the required cross-hardware profile is not finite on both systems
